title: Freeze vecmath and Commons Math multiplication before the numeric rule
description: Compare unmodified public Tuple2f.scale and Vector2D.scalarMultiply calls on the same two independent symbolic binary32 or binary64 binades. Keep separate stock assertions and post-call controls, replay incorrect positivity and unrounded-product oracles on the JVM, and retain each checker invocation and result. expected: Four vecmath rows and one Commons Math row, each with strict native, integrated staged, stock target and stock reach. Physical numeric controls pass.
